title: Sale creator can possibly steal bidders' claimable tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it results in a loss of funds for bidders  **Likelihood:** Medium, as it requires to claim before cliff expires  ## Description  In `StakedVestedCrowdSale` the sale creator can give the address to his own `TokenVesting` & `TimelockedToken` contracts. Same in `VestedCrowdSale` but only for `TimelockedToken`. Now if the sale creator is malicious he can give the addresses of his own deployed contracts that inherit from either `TokenVesting` or `TimelockedToken` but add functionality to pull the funds out on demand, while they are still locked in them.
